description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier called DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert that presents an alert to the user for confirming or declining running an OpenClaw agent based on a deep link prompt stored in the app model. It also provides a View extension for applying this alert.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that presents a confirmation alert for a deep link prompt related to the OpenClaw agent.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Provides the view modifier implementation that displays an alert based on the app model’s pending deep link prompt.

methods.name: promptBinding
methods.description: A private computed property that creates a binding to the pending deep link prompt in the app model, maintaining the prompt's state until user action.
